folkways_core.ponder.book_modes.header: One book, three things a click can mean
folkways_core.ponder.book_modes.text_1: A left click with the book acts on the world. Which of three things it does shows on the book itself.
folkways_core.ponder.book_modes.text_2: Pointing: a left click takes the block or the body under your crosshair into the colony, or back out of it.
folkways_core.ponder.book_modes.text_3: Sneak and scroll turns the book to the next gesture. A second book keeps whatever it was left in.
folkways_core.ponder.book_modes.text_4: Marking out: that same click draws a box instead, one click on each of two opposite corners.
folkways_core.ponder.book_modes.text_5: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on a Mac) and scroll. Before the box is framed this sets a reach, and a Ctrl click drops a corner that far out, in open air. Once it is framed, it pushes the face you aim at in or out.
folkways_core.ponder.book_modes.text_6: Then right click. The panel asks what the ground is for, and the answers come from the parts of Folkways you have installed: a farm, a pasture, a building, and so on.
folkways_core.ponder.book_modes.text_7: Drawing a line: each left click adds a stop, joined to the one before, up to 4096 of them. A right click asks what the path is for.
folkways_core.ponder.book_modes.text_8: Sneak and left click throws the box or line you are drawing away.
folkways_core.ponder.book_modes.text_9: Aimed at a zone or path already marked out, right click opens its settings, whichever gesture the book is in. Anywhere else, it opens the colony panel.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_book.header: A colony is the blocks you mark
folkways_core.ponder.colony_book.text_1: A colony book is crafted from a plain book. It is how you reach your colonies, not what makes them yours.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_book.text_2: A right click opens the colony panel. Before you keep any colony it offers one button, New Colony. Press it, and you are the new colony's founder.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_book.text_3: The colony goes with you, not the book: any colony book opens it. Click the title of the panel to switch between your colonies, or to found another.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_book.text_4: Left click a chest with the book and it joins the colony as storage. Click it again to take it back out.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_book.text_5: Besides containers, only blocks some part of Folkways puts to use can join: a work station, a bed. What each is for is shown where it is used.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_book.text_6: Anything else is refused: the colony has no use for it.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_book.text_7: Bodies take the same click. Pointed at one of your own residents, it lets them go.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_book.text_8: A colony is not a patch of ground you fence off. It is the blocks you marked yourself.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_panel.text_1: A right click with the book opens the colony panel. Its pages are listed down the left side, in three groups.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_panel.text_2: Under Colony come its own pages. Workforce sets each resident's work priorities, and Storage lists what the colony's containers hold.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_panel.text_3: Storage lists every item held in the colony's containers, with how many. Refresh counts again.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_panel.text_4: At the foot of Settings, Delete colony ends the colony for good. It only goes through once you type out the phrase it asks for.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_panel.text_5: Under Production, every installed part of Folkways adds a page: Workshop for the stations, Household for the beds, and so on. Their own lists live there, like the fuel stations may burn and the food residents may eat.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_panel.text_6: Each trade’s page holds its tool list. The list controls which tools residents may acquire for that trade. Unconfigured lists inherit the trade’s kit defaults; an empty list allows no acquisitions.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_panel.text_7: Lessons holds a folder for every installed part of Folkways. Open one to watch a single lesson, or all of them in a row.
folkways_core.ponder.colony_panel.text_8: Anywhere in the panel, hover a page's tab and hold the ponder key to play the lesson for that page.

folkways.combat.help: Select 1–8 loaded residents and create a squad, or choose an existing squad. One point is a guard post; 2–16 points make a looping patrol. Close the book to move, then reopen it to add more points. Commands are released on restart.
folkways.rts.cycle_too_short: A patrol loop needs two distinct points. Add another, then click an earlier marker.
folkways.rts.ground_required: Choose loaded, dry standing ground in the current realm.
folkways.rts.group_card: Group %1$s: %2$s/%3$s available. %1$s recalls; Ctrl+%1$s replaces or disbands identical members.
folkways.rts.help: Select by left-clicking or dragging. Right-click ground to order; Ctrl+right-click to append. Hold Ctrl to review committed route history (not a draft); when open, click a visible marker to append or close. Middle-drag pans, Alt+middle-drag orbits, the wheel zooms, and Walk/Jump/Sneak move the camera.
